sloka: स्मि यदवोचस्त्वमेकपत्नीष्वयं क्रमः ।एवमुक्त्वा स तां रक्षो निवेश्य च शिलातले ।कामभोगाभिसंसक्तो मैथुनायोपचक्रमे ।। ७.२६.४२ ॥
transliteration: smi yadavocastvamekapatnīṣvayaṁ kramaḥ ।evamuktvā sa tāṁ rakṣo niveśya ca śilātale ।kāmabhogābhisaṁsakto maithunāyopacakrame ।। 7.26.42 ॥

translations.english: Having said, "I am what you said, this is the rule among chaste wives," the demon Ravana, deeply engrossed in sensual pleasures, placed her on a rock surface and proceeded to engage in sexual union.
